summary.name: MindMap AI Text Summarizer
summary.one_liner: A free online AI tool that condenses pasted text, articles, or documents into a structured visual mind map summary.
use_cases: Summarizing study notes or lecture notes
Digesting long reports and policy documents
summary.what_it_does: Lets you paste a paragraph, article, or notes into a free text box and click Summarize to generate a structured mind map of the main ideas and supporting details. The page says the AI identifies context, tone, and relationships between ideas. The resulting nodes can be edited, refined with AI, and expanded. Output can be exported as PNG, PDF, SVG, Markdown, or CSV, or shared through public or private links. The page also mentions importing documents and other inputs such as PDF, audio, or video.
notable: Outputs a visual mind map instead of plain bullet points
Editable nodes that can be refined and expanded with AI
Exports to PNG, PDF, SVG, Markdown, or CSV
caveats: Page describes a free plan with unlimited manual use and basic AI summaries; other AI features may require a paid tier (not detailed on the page)
Page does not specify limits on text length or the AI model used
